content.value_statement: Design handoff can slow video composition work. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Figma asset, token, component, storyboard, motion, and shader imports for HyperFrames.
actual_capabilities: Imports static Figma assets into local HyperFrames media files.
Imports Figma brand variables and published styles as composition tokens.
Converts Figma node trees into editable HyperFrames HTML components.
Routes Figma Motion data through MCP and GSAP timeline helpers.
Builds storyboard animatics by matching elements across scene frames.
Freezes imported assets locally so renders do not call Figma at runtime.
limitations: Requires a Figma personal access token for REST-based imports.
Requires the Figma MCP connector for motion and shader workflows.
Figma variable imports depend on account plan and available read scopes.
Shader captures may require native Figma exports because MCP render paths can flatten shaders.

use_cases.title: Prepare Launch Video Assets
use_cases.description: Import product logos, interface frames, and visual assets from Figma into a HyperFrames composition.

use_cases.title: Sync Brand Tokens
use_cases.description: Bring Figma colors and styles into composition variables before building reusable video components.

use_cases.title: Build Storyboard Animatics
use_cases.description: Turn a Figma section of scene frames and notes into a timed HyperFrames animation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Import a Figma Asset
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this Figma link to import the selected logo into my HyperFrames composition. Prefer SVG and freeze it locally with a clear description.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Brand Tokens
prompt_templates.prompt: Import brand colors and styles from this Figma file before component work. Tell me where the token sidecar and variable entries land.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a Frame
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this Figma frame into an editable HyperFrames component. Link imported tokens where possible and flag unresolved bindings.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Motion Animatic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this storyboard section and motion notes to create a HyperFrames animatic. Match recurring elements across frames and validate the composition.

output_examples.input: A Figma logo node URL for a product intro.
output_examples.output: A frozen SVG asset is added to the local media library with provenance, alt text, and a suggested image placement.

output_examples.input: A Figma file that contains brand colors and published styles.
output_examples.output: Composition variables are prepared from available tokens, with notes about any plan-gated variable data.

output_examples.input: A storyboard section with repeated elements and director notes.
output_examples.output: A HyperFrames animatic plan maps scene order, element transitions, holds, and validation steps.

best_practices: Import tokens before components so colors can bind to composition variables.
Freeze every Figma asset locally before rendering the final composition.
Use MCP only for motion or shader cases where REST cannot provide the needed data.
anti_patterns: Leaving live Figma URLs inside the final composition.
Treating storyboard frames as static slides instead of animation keyframes.
Guessing token matches from color values when exact Figma bindings are missing.

faq.question: Does this skill edit my Figma files?
faq.answer: No. The workflow uses read-only Figma access and imports content into local HyperFrames files.

faq.question: Do I need a Figma token?
faq.answer: Yes. REST-based asset, token, and component imports require a Figma personal access token with read scopes.

faq.question: When is the Figma MCP connector needed?
faq.answer: It is needed for motion and shader workflows where Figma does not expose equivalent REST data.

faq.question: Can it import Figma variables on every plan?
faq.answer: No. Variable access depends on Figma plan support and scopes, with published styles used as a fallback.

faq.question: Does the final render call Figma?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs agents to freeze imported assets locally before rendering.

faq.question: Can it turn storyboards into animations?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides agents to match elements across frames and build HyperFrames animatics from those changes.
